conceptZh: 兔子魔術師先變出一個圓滾滾的帽子形狀，發現不尖，輕敲一下，變成上小下大的「尖」。
object: magician rabbit with a top hat and wand
morph: a round blob squashes into a small 小 stacked on a wide 大
creativeAngle: 先變出錯的圓形、發現後一敲修正。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a deep-violet curtain stage with a soft peach spotlight pool; the glyph is a bright tangerine 尖, a small 小 above a wide 大 whose crossbar reads clearly. A cartoon magician rabbit in a top hat stands at left, wand ready. The Traditional Chinese glyph 尖 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the rabbit swishes the wand and a round, plump blob puffs out of the hat; he beams, then squints; the first 尖 is spoken as the blob appears. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the blob is wrong, so he shrugs and taps it once; it squashes into a small 小 floating over a wide 大, snapping together with a bounce; the second 尖 is spoken at the snap. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): a toy pencil with a sharp point pokes from the hat and the rabbit leaps back with a silent open-mouth squeal; 尖叫 is spoken as his ears shoot straight up like two points. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 尖 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the rabbit smooths his ears, tips his hat and takes a bow, the glyph steady. Narration (off-screen only, Taiwanese Mandarin, unhurried, every tone clear, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「尖、尖、尖叫」, read as ㄐㄧㄢ、ㄐㄧㄢ、ㄐㄧㄢ ㄐㄧㄠˋ. Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.5s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only soft magic sparkles and a squeaky pop, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
